sections.heading: SONY — Sony Group
sections.markdown:
**Signal / why now:** new #11 GLOBAL MOMENTUM row ($26.20, −13.4% off the high; mom12 −19.8%, mom6 +25.7%). A `derated_compounder_rerating` shape — FY26 (Mar-26) EBIT a record ¥1,553.7bn (+21.4%) while the 12m price fell ~20%. Fresh auto-dossier built this session.

**Why it fails:** mkt cap ¥24,375bn at the 10-23 local ¥4,126 (ADR parity verified, USD/JPY 156.93) less net cash ¥539.2bn = EV ¥23,836bn → **15.3x FY26 EV/EBIT**. This name's own killed thesis (T-GLOBAL-SONY-001) derived a terminal 1/WACC ≈ **11.8x** and wrote its own falsification line: "if entry already sits above ~12x EV/EBIT, this is multiple expansion wearing a DCF costume." Entry is above it; the +50% up-leg → 22.9x EV/EBIT / 32.9x FY25 EPS.

**Three questions:** (1) Decompose the FY26 net loss (−¥326.9bn; Mar-26 quarter −¥1,008.6bn) and the halved asset base (¥35.3tn → ¥15.7tn) — SFG deconsolidation or an operating charge? (2) Is I&SS durably intact vs Apple dual-sourcing? (3) What forward catalyst exists that the 07-22 `catalyst` kill did not reject?

**Fast-disqualify:** EV at `derated_compounder_rerating` (0.40/50/−30) = **+0.7%/yr**, under the ~4%/yr hurdle. Target check **NO**. Sources ✓ (Sony IR). $26.20 is **24.6% above** the 07-22 kill ($21.02) with its dispositive reason unrebutted → DISCARD. **Re-advance:** ≤ ~$19.53 ADR (the 12x line) **and** the FY26 loss decomposed as non-operating.
